Kenichi Suzumura (Japanese: 鈴村健一 Suzumura Ken'ichi) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Suzumura was born on September 12, 1974, in , , but was raised in . He became a voice actor as an adult and eventually got a number of significant roles in Japanese anime series. Suzumura joined the during , but got his most notable role in that work, Hoenn Steven Stone, during , replacing Rintarō Nishi. In addition to performing voice acting roles, Suzumura has also dubbed a multitude of roles in international films and shows, both live-action and animated. He was once affiliated with the talent agency , but he eventually left and founded his own agency, INTENTION, on May 8, 2009. He married a fellow voice actress, , on August 8, 2011. Suzumura and Sakamoto announced they were expecting their first child on December 27, 2021. Their first child was born on April 21, 2022.
